description: The image is a ground-level photograph depicting a residential area, specifically an example of "Low density urban fabric". The foreground features a heart-shaped swimming pool with blue tiles, encircled by light-coloured paved surfacing. This pool is set within a large, predominantly green lawn, which includes a tall palm tree on the left and various shrubs and other vegetation. In the background, several white residential buildings with terracotta-coloured roofs are visible, interspersed among green foliage. The scene illustrates a residential setting where vegetated areas are predominant, but also includes significant artificial surfaces like the pool and paving, consistent with the description of "Low dense Urban" land cover types.
